mapper.select: SELECT z.* FROM service_zone z JOIN shipper_zone_assignment a ON a.zone_id = z.id WHERE a.shipper_id = #{shipperId} AND a.active = TRUE AND z.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT * FROM pickup_session WHERE shipper_id = #{shipperId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pickup_session ( id, shipper_id, hub_id, zone_id, vehicle_id, start_latitude, start_longitude, planned_start_at, desired_return_at, status, route_plan ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{shipperId}, #{hubId}, #{zoneId}, #{vehicleId}, #{startLatitude}, #{startLongitude}, #{plannedStartAt}, #{desiredReturnAt}, #{status}, CAST(#{routePlan} AS JSONB) )
